text: The lengthy and complex Ontario Line and Transit Oriented Community processes continue to impact many residents in our communities. The litany of ongoing changes and updates including provincially imposed Municipal Zoning Orders (MZOs) add to the frustration and confusion experienced by residents. Residents have repeatedly requested an in-person public open house as a vehicle to support their efforts to have their questions answered.
City Council on October 8 and 9, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council request Infrastructure Ontario to hold all Transit Oriented Community meetings in person.
